questions.scenario: It's peak summer in May and the society water tank runs dry. How do you handle this water crisis?

options.text: Physically going down to check the society motor, guiding the water tanker, and organizing buckets for everyone.
Calculating exactly how many liters each flat consumed and analyzing the daily water wastage patterns.
Making a dramatic WhatsApp forward or poster urging neighbors to stop washing their cars with a water hose.
Pitching a formal idea to the RWA (Resident Welfare Association) to install a rainwater harvesting system before monsoon.

questions.scenario: You are at the local sabzi mandi with Mummy and the vendor gives you a flimsy black polythene bag. What do you do?

options.text: Quickly pull out the sturdy cloth 'jhola' you brought from home and physically transfer all the veggies into it.
Wonder about the exact micron thickness of the plastic and how many hundreds of years it will take to degrade in a landfill.
Think about designing a super cool, aesthetic canvas tote bag with catchy slogans that teenagers would actually want to carry.
Suggest to the local market committee to strictly charge an extra ₹5 for plastic bags to hit people's wallets and discourage use.

questions.scenario: It's the morning after Diwali and the city's AQI (Air Quality Index) is off the charts with heavy smog. What is your reaction?

options.text: Put on an N95 mask and go down to spray water on the dry dusty patches in the society to manually settle the particulate matter.
Open the SAFAR app to check exact PM2.5 and PM10 levels, comparing today's toxic data with last year's graphs.
Make a hard-hitting Instagram Reel showing the grey, smoggy skyline set to a trending emotional song to spread awareness.
Read up on government policies regarding stubble burning and draft a letter to the local MLA demanding stricter enforcement.

questions.scenario: Your school is celebrating World Environment Day (5th June). What is your main role in the event?

options.text: Getting your hands muddy in the school garden, digging holes, and actively planting neem and peepal saplings.
Conducting a school-wide electricity audit to record which classrooms waste the most fan and AC power during recess.
Painting a massive, beautiful backdrop banner for the main stage that says 'Save Earth, Save Life'.
Organizing the entire event, managing the ₹50 contribution collected from students, and deciding the agenda.

questions.scenario: You find a sick stray puppy or street dog near a massive garbage dump outside your society. What is your response?

options.text: Physically pick it up, wrap it carefully in an old towel, and run to the nearest local animal dispensary or vet.
Research the rising statistics of urban stray diseases caused by the ingestion of toxic plastic wrappers.
Take an emotional video of the puppy, tag local animal rescue NGOs on Instagram, and crowdsource help.
Start a society fund to organize a proper wet/dry waste segregation drive so animals stop eating garbage in the first place.

questions.scenario: You are on a family trip to Manali and see tourists throwing chips packets into the beautiful valley. How do you react?

options.text: Climb down a bit to the ledge, pick up the wrappers yourself, and throw them in a designated dustbin.
Calculate the volume of solid waste generated by tourists per season versus the small hill station's recycling capacity.
Vlog the incident, ranting about irresponsible tourists ruining the pristine Himalayan beauty for everyone else.
Talk to your hotel manager about introducing eco-friendly glass water bottles and bulk dispensers instead of single-use plastics.

questions.scenario: You notice your school leaves all the corridor lights and fans running even after everyone goes home. What do you do?

options.text: Physically walk through all three floors of the building and switch off every single main board yourself.
Calculate the exact electricity bill the school is wasting per month and graph their unnecessary carbon footprint.
Make sarcastic memes about the school's 'hypocrisy' on saving energy and share them on the student WhatsApp groups.
Propose a formal 'Green Monitor' badge program to the Principal to enforce electricity discipline in every class.

questions.scenario: There is a Sunday mega cleanliness drive at a dirty local lake or the Yamuna ghats. What is your job?

options.text: Wear the big rubber boots, grab a net, and spend hours pulling out wet clothes and religious plastic waste from the muddy water.
Take water samples in a small bottle to test the pH level, dissolved oxygen, and chemical toxicity from nearby factories.
Handle the drone or DSLR camera to shoot epic 'Before and After' shots of the cleanup for social media reach.
Coordinate with the local municipality to bring the garbage trucks and arrange sponsorships for volunteer breakfasts.

questions.scenario: Your desk drawer is full of broken earphones, old Nokia phones, and tangled chargers. What is your plan?

options.text: Physically collect all the wires in a box and travel to the nearest designated e-waste recycling drop-off center.
Research the heavy metals inside (like lithium and lead) and read up on how they poison groundwater if thrown in normal trash.
Use the colorful tangled wires, old keypads, and broken screens to create a cool modern art piece or a DIY phone cover.
Convince your society secretary to host an 'E-Waste Collection Day' where a verified recycling company buys it all in bulk.

questions.scenario: Your family is debating whether to buy a petrol car or an EV (Electric Vehicle) like a Tata Nexon. What is your input?

options.text: You care most about maintaining it, planning exactly how you will set up the physical charging socket in your parking lot.
You analyze the exact battery life cycle, charging costs per km, and whether the state's electricity grid is actually powered by coal.
You focus on how silent and futuristic it looks, imagining the cool aesthetic road trip vlogs you can make with the green number plate.
You calculate the long-term ROI (Return on Investment) and government tax subsidies before advising your parents to invest.

Field_Conservationist.title: The Ground Guardian (Field Conservationist)
Field_Conservationist.primary_match_text: You are a hands-on earth warrior! You don't just talk about saving the planet; you like to get your hands dirty, plant trees, and physically protect nature and animals.
Field_Conservationist.day_in_the_life: Trekking through forests to track wildlife, planting hundreds of saplings, cleaning up polluted rivers, and rescuing injured animals.
Field_Conservationist.alternative_match_text: Your love for the outdoors and animals would also make you a fantastic Forest Ranger, Wildlife Photographer, or Veterinarian.
Field_Conservationist.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Science (PCB). Entrance: CUET or State Agriculture Exams. Degree: B.Sc in Forestry, Zoology, or Environmental Science. Next Steps: Join NGOs, Wildlife Institutes, or prepare for the Indian Forest Service (IFS).

Climate_Analyst.title: The Eco-Nerd (Climate Data Analyst)
Climate_Analyst.primary_match_text: You are a logical thinker who loves the science behind the environment! You know that fighting climate change requires tracking numbers, reading satellite maps, and analyzing hard data.
Climate_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Checking air quality indexes (AQI), studying satellite images of deforestation, tracking global warming trends, and modeling carbon emissions on a computer.
Climate_Analyst.alternative_match_text: Your sharp analytical skills and love for science would also make you a great Data Scientist, Meteorologist (Weather Scientist), or Geologist.
Climate_Analyst.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Science (PCM/PCB). Degree: B.Sc in Environmental Science, Geography, or Statistics. Next Steps: Pursue an M.Sc in Climate Science, GIS (Geographic Information Systems), or Environmental Modeling.

Eco_Content_Creator.title: The Green Influencer (Eco-Awareness Content Creator)
Eco_Content_Creator.primary_match_text: You are a creative soul with a powerful voice! You use art, videos, and storytelling to make sustainability look cool and inspire thousands of people to change their habits.
Eco_Content_Creator.day_in_the_life: Shooting viral reels on sustainable fashion, designing striking posters about plastic pollution, or writing emotional scripts for nature documentaries.
Eco_Content_Creator.alternative_match_text: Your artistic flair and communication skills would also make you an incredible Digital Marketer, Filmmaker, or Environmental Journalist.
Eco_Content_Creator.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Humanities, Arts, or Any Stream. Degree: BMM (Bachelor of Mass Media), BA in Journalism, or Design (NID/NIFT). Next Steps: Build a strong online portfolio focusing on eco-journalism and sustainable living.

Sustainability_Consultant.title: The Green Boss (Sustainability Policy Consultant)
Sustainability_Consultant.primary_match_text: You are a visionary leader with a business mind! You understand that to save the planet, you have to change how big companies and governments spend their money.
Sustainability_Consultant.day_in_the_life: Advising giant MNCs on how to switch to solar power, managing multi-crore CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) green funds, and drafting new eco-friendly city policies.
Sustainability_Consultant.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and strategic thinking would also make you a brilliant Urban Planner, Corporate Lawyer, or Eco-Entrepreneur.
Sustainability_Consultant.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce or Humanities. Degree: BBA, B.Com, or BA Economics. Next Steps: Crack CAT -> Pursue an MBA in Sustainability Management or a Master's in Environmental Economics/Policy.
